sources.title: Telescope spots galaxy from 290 million years after the Big Bang
sources.text: Astronomers using the space telescope confirmed a galaxy observed just 290 million years after the Big Bang, the most distant ever measured.

sources.title: How the telescope's gold mirror works
sources.text: The telescope's primary mirror is 6.5 metres across and made of 18 gold-coated hexagonal segments.
